stem: What is a recognized substrate for β-galactosidase?
rationale: A similar scheme relying on production of an in-frame fusion of a newly inserted DNA producing a peptide fragment capable of complementing an inactive, N-terminally truncated form of the enzyme β-galactosidase allows for blue-white colony formation on agar plates containing a dye hydrolyzable by β-galactosidase.
